_doc: PRIORITIZE-1: weights the ranker (foundation/prioritize.py) uses. Edit by reviewed PR; the ranker's output is docs/PRIORITY-QUEUE.md and the score the executor sorts by.

goals.why: loops must not depend on GitHub Actions minutes or any person's machine; GitHub Actions is billing-blocked 2026-11-14
second product must run entirely on the platform (bootstrap from idea, own cycle)
north star: verified deploys per day without human input
spend under budget; budget breach steers to cheaper models
readers, pilots, funding after the loops sustain themselves
ULTRASTABILITY-1 knob for deploy_health: the second loop raises it when verified deploys fall out of bounds, so the executor takes deploy repairs first
ULTRASTABILITY-1 knob for claims_drift: raised when a claim stops matching the code (say-do), so the executor takes the fix first
ULTRASTABILITY-1 knob for ui_findings and happy_paths: raised when the front end drifts
ULTRASTABILITY-1 knob for unattended_horizon: raised when the year simulation projects less than a year unattended
ULTRASTABILITY-1 knob for self_shipping: raised when the server is not originating and shipping its own deploys

pins._doc: critical path, in order: each pinned item gets this bonus so it outranks any goal match until it closes

constraints.why: GitHub Actions jobs refused since 2026-11-14 (billing); every loop on Actions is down until it runs on the Worker
control rods: spend over budget makes cost-cutting the binding constraint
k under floor: items that raise verified deploys come first
